answer: A head spends its willow once, vouching one newcomer whose base it locks; a proven fake forfeits that base and the vouching head's lantern to the newcomer's hollow, whose judges live on forfeits and hunt hard. A vouched head's lantern stays dark until it serves N judged epochs under those judges, and only a lit lantern may spend a willow — so clones chain, the k-th waiting on the (k−1)-th's light: k×N attested epochs in series that no capital compresses. A fresh newcomer takes a veteran's willow at once; buying one instead costs the veteran's whole judged history.
